last-minute--adj.def: Done at the latest possible time.
last-minute--adj.ex: It was a last minute change.

circumstance--noun.def: A fact or condition that affects a situation.

interpret--verb.def: To explain the meaning of something, or to translate speech.
interpret--verb.ex: How do you interpret this rule?

salsa--noun.def: A spicy sauce, or a Latin American dance.

dread--verb.def: To feel very worried about something that will happen.

irrational--adj.def: Not based on clear thinking or reason.
irrational--adj.ex: He has an irrational fear of cats.
irrational--adj.exTr: Kedilere karşı mantıksız bir korkusu var.

upgrade--noun.def: An improvement to a better version or class.

upgrade--verb.def: To change something for a better version.

rim--noun.def: The outer edge of a round object.
rim--noun.ex: The rim of the cup is chipped.

decisive--adj.def: Settling a question, or able to decide quickly.

symbolic--adj.def: Representing an idea rather than being practical.

bankruptcy--noun.def: The state of being unable to pay your debts.

catering--noun.def: The business of providing food for events.
catering--noun.ex: A local firm does the catering.
catering--noun.exTr: Yemek hizmetini yerel bir firma veriyor.

shaky--adj.def: Shaking slightly, or not firm and reliable.

barren--adj.ex: The hills are dry and barren.

index--noun.def: An alphabetical list at the back of a book, or a measure of change.
index--noun.ex: Look it up in the index.

blush--verb.def: To become red in the face from embarrassment.

twinkle--noun.def: A light that shines on and off, or a look of amusement.
twinkle--noun.ex: There was a twinkle in his eye.

motorbike--noun.def: A two-wheeled vehicle with an engine.

evolve--verb.def: To develop gradually over a long time.

tenderness--noun.def: Gentle kindness, or soreness when touched.

attendance--noun.def: The number of people present, or the act of going regularly.

linen--noun.def: A strong cloth made from flax.

patriotic--adj.def: Showing strong love for your country.

decorate--verb.def: To make something look more attractive.
decorate--verb.ex: They decorated the hall with flowers.

drought--noun.def: A long period with no rain.

tug--noun.ex: He felt a tug on the line.

balanced--adj.def: Having the right amounts of different parts.

clause--noun.def: A part of a legal document, or a part of a sentence.

neglect--noun.def: A failure to care for someone or something.
neglect--noun.ex: The building shows years of neglect.

mango--noun.def: A sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh.

decay--verb.def: To be slowly destroyed by natural processes.
decay--verb.ex: The wood decayed in the damp.

miniature--adj.def: Much smaller than the normal size.

span--verb.def: To reach across a space or a period of time.
span--verb.ex: The bridge spans the whole river.

windshield--noun.def: The glass at the front of a car, in American English.

edit--noun.def: A change made to improve a text or a film.
edit--noun.ex: The final edit took a week.

edit--verb.def: To correct and improve a text or a film.

supervision--noun.def: The act of watching over work or people.

winding--adj.ex: A winding road climbs the hill.

amuse--verb.def: To make someone laugh or enjoy themselves.

dominate--verb.def: To have control over something, or to be the main feature.

violate--verb.def: To break a rule, a law or an agreement.

transmit--verb.def: To send out a signal, or to pass on a disease.

soaking--adj.ex: His coat was soaking after the walk.

navigation--noun.def: The skill of finding the way for a ship or a plane.
navigation--noun.ex: Navigation was hard in the fog.

margin--noun.def: The blank edge of a page, or the amount by which you win.

amazingly--adv.def: In a way that is very surprising.

sincerity--noun.def: The quality of really meaning what you say.

digest--noun.def: A short collection of the main news or facts.
digest--noun.ex: The weekly digest arrives on Friday.

weave--noun.def: The pattern in which threads are crossed in cloth.
weave--noun.ex: The weave is tight and even.

landlady--noun.def: A woman who rents out a house or a room.

eligible--adj.def: Allowed to do or receive something.
eligible--adj.ex: Students are eligible for a discount.

transparent--adj.def: Clear enough to see through, or open and honest.

sneeze--verb.def: To push air suddenly out of your nose and mouth.

preferably--adv.def: Used to say which choice would be better.

exhaust--noun.def: The gases from an engine, or the pipe they leave by.
exhaust--noun.ex: Black smoke came from the exhaust.

relic--noun.def: An object that survives from the past.
relic--noun.ex: The museum holds a rare relic.

merger--noun.def: The joining of two companies into one.
merger--noun.ex: The merger created a large firm.

rubble--noun.def: Broken stones and bricks from a fallen building.

flap--verb.def: To move wings or cloth quickly up and down.

prevail--verb.def: To win in the end, or to be common in a place.

anguish--noun.ex: Her letter is full of anguish.

colonial--adj.def: Relating to a country ruled by a distant power.
colonial--adj.ex: The building is colonial in style.

diarrhea--noun.def: An illness in which waste leaves the body as liquid.

disregard--noun.def: A lack of attention or respect for something.
disregard--noun.ex: He showed total disregard for safety.

exclusively--adv.def: Only, and for nobody or nothing else.
exclusively--adv.ex: The club is exclusively for members.

disciple--noun.def: A follower of a teacher or a religious leader.

hedge--noun.def: A line of bushes planted as a boundary.
hedge--noun.ex: A thick hedge marks the field.

suppress--verb.def: To stop something by force, or to hold back a feeling.

witty--adj.def: Clever and amusing in what you say.

intersection--noun.def: A place where two roads cross.

supplier--noun.def: A company that provides goods to another.

suspend--verb.def: To stop something for a period, or to hang it.

gateway--noun.def: An entrance, or a place giving access to a region.
gateway--noun.ex: The port is a gateway to Asia.

pavement--noun.def: The path beside a road, in British English.
